cohort: This study included 10 neonates diagnosed with chylothorax between 2012 and 2020 at a single tertiary neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: In this cohort, 80% of neonates with chylothorax achieved full recovery with octreotide treatment (some also undergoing thoracic duct ligation or intrauterine thoracentesis), while 20% died, and no short-term recurrence was observed in surviving cases.
